description: The header for a scope group (Shared / Private to you) in the Advisor Memory list: a color-independent scope chip (icon + word + color) with a subtitle and a count badge. Replaces the local groupHeader in app/settings/advisor-memory.tsx.

scope.description: Drives icon + color. Always paired with the title word so scope is never color-only.

title.description: 'Shared' or 'Private to you' — the word rendered inside the scope chip.

subtitle.description: e.g. 'Both partners can see these' / 'Only you — never shown to your partner'. typography.caption, colors.textMuted, numberOfLines 1.

count.description: Number of facts in this scope; shown in the count badge.

accessibility.label: {title}, {subtitle}, {count} {count === 1 ? 'memory' : 'memories'}
accessibility.colorIndependence: Scope chip always shows an icon (people/lock) + the literal word + color, so Shared vs Private never relies on hue alone.

notes: Only render a group when it has ≥1 item (existing behavior). Shared uses colors.primary2, Private uses colors.info to keep the two hues distinct while both stay on-palette.
